Берсерк.name: Berserker
Берсерк.text: **Berserker:** You channel your ferocity into physical might, acting as a living version of the forces that shape the world. You have the Lift skill.

Разоритель.name: Reaver
Разоритель.text: **Reaver:** You channel your ferocity into instinct and cunning, challenging the order of civilization. You have the Hide skill.

Буревестник.name: Stormwight
Буревестник.text: **Stormwight:** You channel your ferocity into primordial storms and can take on the form of an animal or an animal hybrid form. You have the Track skill.

Псионическая аугментация.name: Psionic Augmentation
Псионическая аугментация.text: Your training has turned your body into the perfect psionic weapon, shaping pathways in your mind that enhance your physical form. Choose one of the following augmentations. You can change your augmentation by undergoing a psionic meditation as a respite activity. (*Quick Build:* Speed Augmentation.)

Аугментация плотности (Density Augmentat.name: Density Augmentation
Аугментация плотности (Density Augmentat.text: You gain a +6 bonus to Stamina, and this bonus increases by 6 at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels. Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus to stability.

Аугментация силы (Force Augmentation).name: Force Augmentation
Аугментация силы (Force Augmentation).text: Your damage-dealing psionic abilities gain a +1 bonus to rolled damage.

Аугментация скорости (Speed Augmentation.name: Speed Augmentation
Аугментация скорости (Speed Augmentation.text: You gain a +1 bonus to speed and to the distance you can shift when you take the Disengage move action.

Хронокинетик.name: Chronokinetic
Хронокинетик.text: **Chronokinetic:** Your training unmoors you from temporal reality, allowing you to use the flow of time as another dimension that all things move through. You gain one skill from the lore group.

Криокинетик.name: Cryokinetic
Криокинетик.text: **Cryokinetic:** You can tap into absolute cold, the most essential energy of myriad manifolds, and manifest its effects in your body. You gain one skill from the crafting group.

Метакинетик.name: Metakinetic
Метакинетик.text: **Metakinetic:** You learn to see through the illusions of the universe to more fully understand your body and its psionic potential. You gain one skill from the exploration group.

Молитва.name: Prayer
Молитва.text: Your god answers a prayer with enhancements to your body and mind. Choose one of the following prayers. You can change your prayer along with your ward (see Conduit Ward below) by praying to your god as a respite activity. (*Quick Build:* Prayer of Distance.)

Молитва о разрушении.name: Prayer of Destruction
Молитва о разрушении.text: Your god infuses wrath within your being. You gain a +1 bonus to rolled damage with magic abilities.

Молитва о дистанции.name: Prayer of Distance
Молитва о дистанции.text: Your god blesses you with the ability to stretch your divine magic farther. You have a +2 bonus to the distance of your ranged magic abilities.

Молитва о мастерстве солдата.name: Prayer of Soldier's Skill
Молитва о мастерстве солдата.text:
Your god gives your mind the training of a soldier. You can wear light armor and wield light weapons effectively, even though you don't have a kit. While you wear light armor, you gain a +3 bonus to Stamina, and that bonus increases by 3 at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels. While you wield a light weapon, you gain a +1 damage bonus with weapon abilities, including free strikes. You can use light armor treasures and light weapon treasures.

If you have a kit, you can't take this blessing.

Молитва о скорости.name: Prayer of Speed
Молитва о скорости.text: Your god blesses your flesh and infuses it with divine quickness. You gain a +1 bonus to speed and to the distance you can shift when you take the Disengage move action.

Молитва о стали.name: Prayer of Steel
Молитва о стали.text: Your god fills your body with the light of creation, making you harder to hurt and move. You gain a +6 bonus to Stamina, and this bonus increases by 6 at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels. Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus to stability.

Оберег проводника.name: Conduit Ward
Оберег проводника.text: Your god grants you a ward that protects you from the faithless. Choose one of the following wards. You can change your ward along with your prayer (see Prayer above) by praying to your god as a respite activity. (*Quick Build:* Bastion Ward.)

Оберег бастиона.name: Bastion Ward
Оберег бастиона.text: Your god grants you a holy countenance that protects you at all times. You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws.

Оберег реакции.name: Quickness Ward
Оберег реакции.text: The gods imbue a divine swiftness within you. Whenever an adjacent creature deals damage to you, you can shift up to a number of squares equal to your Intuition score after the damage is dealt.

Оберег святилища.name: Sanctuary Ward
Оберег святилища.text: In response to a foe's aggression, your god protects you. Whenever another creature damages you, that creature can't target you with a strike until you harm them or one of their allies, or until the end of their next turn.

Оберег духов.name: Spirit Ward
Оберег духов.text: Invisible spirits surround you if you are harmed. Whenever an adjacent creature deals damage to you, they take corruption damage equal to your Intuition score.

Созидание.name: Creation
Созидание.text:
- **Piety:** You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that a creature within 10 squares uses an area ability.
- **Prayer Effect:** You summon the forces of creation and create a wall of stone within 10 squares whose size is 5 + your Intuition score. The wall lasts until the end of the encounter.

Смерть.name: Death
Смерть.text:
- **Piety:** You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that a creature within 10 squares who isn't a minion is reduced to 0 Stamina, or the first time in an encounter that a solo creature within 10 squares becomes winded.
- **Prayer Effect:** You inflict a deadly curse on up to two enemies within 10 squares of you. Each target takes corruption damage equal to twice your Intuition score.

Судьба.name: Fate
Судьба.text:
- **Piety:** You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that an ally within 10 squares obtains a tier 3 outcome on a power roll, or an enemy within 10 squares obtains a tier 1 outcome on a power roll.
- **Prayer Effect:** You call on the forces of fate to create a reliable future. Choose a creature within 10 squares. That creature automatically obtains a tier 1 or tier 3 outcome (your choice) on their next power roll made before the end of the encounter.

Знание.name: Knowledge
Знание.text:
- **Piety:** You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that the Director spends Malice (see *Draw Steel: Monsters*).
- **Prayer Effect:** Choose up to five allies within 10 squares of you, or choose yourself instead of one ally. Each target gains 1 surge.

Жизнь.name: Life
Жизнь.text:
- **Piety:** You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that a creature within 10 squares regains Stamina.
- **Prayer Effect:** Choose yourself or one ally within 10 squares. That character can spend a Recovery, can end one effect on them that is ended by a saving throw or that ends at the end of their turn, or can stand up if they are prone. Alternatively, you or one ally within 10 squares gains temporary Stamina equal to two times your Intuition score.

Любовь.name: Love
Любовь.text:
- **Piety:** You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that you or any ally within 10 squares uses the Aid Attack maneuver or an ability that targets an ally.
- **Prayer Effect:** Each ally within 10 squares of you gains temporary Stamina equal to two times your Intuition score.

Природа.name: Nature
Природа.text:
- **Piety:** You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that you or a creature within 10 squares takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic damage.
- **Prayer Effect:** Vines whip up from the floor or ground within 10 squares, wrapping around a number of creatures equal to your Intuition score. You can slide each creature up to a number of squares equal to your Intuition score. The vines then fade away.

Защита.name: Protection
Защита.text:
- **Piety:** You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that you or any ally within 10 squares gains temporary Stamina, or uses a triggered action to reduce incoming damage or to impose a bane or double bane on an enemy's power roll.
- **Prayer Effect:** One ally within 10 squares gains temporary Stamina equal to four times your Intuition score.

Буря.name: Storm
Буря.text:
- **Piety:** You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that an enemy within 10 squares is force moved.
- **Prayer Effect:** Each enemy in a 3 cube within 10 squares takes lightning damage equal to twice your Intuition score.

Солнце.name: Sun
Солнце.text:
- **Piety:** You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that an enemy within 10 squares takes fire or holy damage.
- **Prayer Effect:** One enemy within 10 squares takes fire damage equal to three times your Intuition score.

Хитрость.name: Trickery
Хитрость.text:
- **Piety:** You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that you or a creature within 10 squares takes the Aid Attack or Hide maneuver.
- **Prayer Effect:** You slide one creature within 10 squares of you up to a number of squares equal to 5 + your conduit level.

Война.name: War
Война.text:
- **Piety:** You gain 2 piety the first time in an encounter that you or a creature within 10 squares takes damage greater than 10 + your level in a single turn.
- **Prayer Effect:** Choose up to three allies within 10 squares of you, or choose yourself instead of one ally. Each target gains 2 surges.

Повстанец.name: Insurgent
Повстанец.text: **Insurgent:** Doing your duty, playing fair, and dying honorably in battle is your opponent's job. You'll do whatever it takes to keep your allies alive. You gain a skill from the intrigue skill group.

Воевода.name: Mastermind
Воевода.text: **Mastermind:** You have an encyclopedic knowledge of warfare, viewing the battlefield as a game board and seeking victory by thinking steps ahead of your opponents. You gain a skill from the lore skill group.

Авангард.name: Vanguard
Авангард.text: **Vanguard:** You have learned the stratagems of ancient heroes, letting you lead from the front lines and seek victory through sheer force of will and personality. You gain a skill from the interpersonal skill group.

Псионическая аугментация.name: Psionic Augmentation
Псионическая аугментация.text: Through meditation, you create pathways in your mind that enhance your statistics. Choose one of the following augmentations. You can change your augmentation and ward (see Talent Ward below) by undergoing a psionic meditation as a respite activity. (*Quick Build:*  Force Augmentation.)

Боевая аугментация.name: Battle Augmentation
Боевая аугментация.text:
You can wear light armor and wield light weapons effectively, even though you don't have a kit. While you wear light armor, you gain a +3 bonus to Stamina, and that bonus increases by 3 at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels. While you wield a light weapon, you gain a +1 damage bonus with weapon abilities, including free strikes. You can use light armor treasures and light weapon treasures.

If you have a kit, you can't take this augmentation.

Аугментация плотности.name: Density Augmentation
Аугментация плотности.text: You gain a +6 bonus to Stamina, and this bonus increases by 6 at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels. Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus to stability.

Аугментация дистанции.name: Distance Augmentation
Аугментация дистанции.text: Your ranged psionic abilities gain a +2 bonus to distance.

Аугментация силы.name: Force Augmentation
Аугментация силы.text: Your damage-dealing psionic abilities gain a +1 bonus to rolled damage.

Аугментация скорости.name: Speed Augmentation
Аугментация скорости.text: You gain a +1 bonus to speed and to the distance you can shift when you take the Disengage move action.

Оберег таланта.name: Talent Ward
Оберег таланта.text: Through meditation, you create a ward that protects you. Choose one of the following wards. You can change your ward and psionic augmentation (see above) by undergoing a psionic meditation as a respite activity. (*Quick Build:* Repulsive Ward.)

Оберег энтропии.name: Entropy Ward
Оберег энтропии.text: Your ward slows time for your enemies. Whenever a creature deals damage to you, their speed is reduced by an amount equal to your Reason score and they can't use triggered actions until the end of their next turn.

Отталкивающий оберег.name: Repulsive Ward
Отталкивающий оберег.text: You surround yourself with an invisible ward of telekinetic energy. Whenever an adjacent creature deals damage to you, you can use a free triggered action to push them up to a number of squares equal to your Reason score.

Стальной оберег.name: Steel Ward
Стальной оберег.text: Your ward reacts to danger, protecting you from future harm. Whenever you take damage, after the damage resolves, you gain damage immunity equal to your Reason score until the end of your next turn.

Исчезающий оберег.name: Vanishing Ward
Исчезающий оберег.text: Your ward allows you to slip away from threats. Whenever you take damage, you become invisible until the end of your next turn.

Хронопатия.name: Chronopathy
Хронопатия.text: **Chronopathy** abilities allow you to view future and past events, and to manipulate time to aid allies and hinder foes.

Телекинез.name: Telekinesis
Телекинез.text: **Telekinesis** abilities allow you to physically manipulate creatures and objects.

Телепатия.name: Telepathy
Телепатия.text: **Telepathy** abilities allow you to communicate with, read, and influence the minds of other creatures.

Коллегия Черного Пепла.name: College of Black Ash
Коллегия Черного Пепла.text: College of Black Ash: The College of Black Ash founded the art of being a shadow. Its graduates are unmatched in mobility, using sorcery to teleport around the battlefield, manipulate shadows, and summon darkness. You have the Magic skill.

Коллегия Едкой Алхимии.name: College of Caustic Alchemy
Коллегия Едкой Алхимии.text: College of Caustic Alchemy: The College of Caustic Alchemy teaches its students recipes for the acids, bombs, and poisons used in their grim work. Graduates of the college are exceptional assassins. You have the Alchemy skill.

Коллегия Маски Арлекина.name: College of the Harlequin Mask
Коллегия Маски Арлекина.text: College of the Harlequin Mask: Graduates of the College of the Harlequin Mask learn illusion magic, which they use to infiltrate enemy strongholds and create orchestrated chaos in combat. You have the Lie skill.

Автор.name: Auteur
Автор.text: **Auteur:** You seek drama from story and recount, using your magic to manipulate the sequence of events unfolding before you. You have the Brag skill.

Дуэлянт.name: Duelist
Дуэлянт.text: **Duelist:** Drama infuses your every movement done in tandem with another. You perform dances of death, putting trust in your opponent to return your passion in kind. You have the Gymnastics skill.

Виртуоз.name: Virtuoso
Виртуоз.text: **Virtuoso:** You find drama in music and song, weaving magic between vibrations and filling the audience with your pathos. You have the Music skill and can play an instrument.

Экзорцист.name: Exorcist
Экзорцист.text: **Exorcist:** You specialize in hunting your order's hidden enemies, knowing that an open mind is an unguarded fortress. You have the Read Person skill.

Оракул.name: Oracle
Оракул.text: **Oracle:** Corruption has deep tendrils that can be missed, leading you to specialize in uncovering clandestine threats to your order. You have the Magic skill.

Идеал.name: Paragon
Идеал.text: **Paragon:** Without a strong example and a firm hand, the weak will be corrupted. You specialize in setting an example for your order. You have the Lead skill.

Зачарование.name: Enchantment
Зачарование.text: You weave an elemental enchantment into your body that enhances your statistics. Choose one of the following enchantments. You can change your enchantment and ward (see Elementalist Ward below) by performing a complex ritual as a respite activity. (*Quick Build:*  Enchantment of Destruction.)

Зачарование битвы.name: Enchantment of Battle
Зачарование битвы.text:
You can wear light armor and wield light weapons effectively, even though you don't have a kit. While you wear light armor, you gain a +3 bonus to Stamina, and that bonus increases by 3 at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels. While you wield a light weapon, you gain a +1 damage bonus with weapon abilities, including free strikes. You can use light armor treasures and light weapon treasures.

If you have a kit, you can't take this enchantment.

Зачарование быстроты.name: Enchantment of Celerity
Зачарование быстроты.text: You gain a +1 bonus to speed and to the distance you can shift when you take the Disengage move action.

Зачарование разрушения.name: Enchantment of Destruction
Зачарование разрушения.text: You gain a +1 bonus to rolled damage with magic abilities.

Зачарование дистанции.name: Enchantment of Distance
Зачарование дистанции.text: You have a +2 bonus to the distance of your ranged magic abilities.

Зачарование постоянства.name: Enchantment of Permanence
Зачарование постоянства.text: You gain a +6 bonus to Stamina, and this bonus increases by 6 at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels. Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus to stability.

Оберег элементалиста.name: Elementalist Ward
Оберег элементалиста.text: You create an invisible elemental ward that protects you. Choose one of the following wards. You can change your ward and enchantment (see above) by performing a complex ritual as a respite activity. (*Quick Build:*  Ward of Surprising Reactivity.)

Оберег восхитительных последствий.name: Ward of Delightful Consequences
Оберег восхитительных последствий.text: A protective field of void magic absorbs violence aimed at you, then lets you hurl it back at your enemies. The first time each round that you take damage, you gain 1 surge.

Оберег превосходной защиты.name: Ward of Excellent Protection
Оберег превосходной защиты.text: You weave a shield of all the elements around yourself, channeling their full protective power. You have immunity to acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic damage equal to your Reason score.

Оберег привязанности природы.name: Ward of Nature's Affection
Оберег привязанности природы.text: The green energy writhing within your body allows you to produce powerful vines when you're in danger. Whenever a creature within a number of squares equal to your Reason score deals damage to you, you can use a free triggered action to slide that creature up to a number of squares equal to your Reason score.

Оберег удивительной реактивности.name: Ward of Surprising Reactivity
Оберег удивительной реактивности.text: You use the magic of fire to create a ward of explosive energy. Whenever an adjacent creature deals damage to you, you can use a free triggered action to push that creature up to a number of squares equal to twice your Reason score.

Земля.name: Earth
Земля.text: **Earth** is the element of permanence. Earth abilities bolster your body and grant the power to permanently create and shape physical terrain.

Огонь.name: Fire
Огонь.text: **Fire** is the element of destruction. Fire abilities devastate enemies and melt objects to slag.

Зелень.name: Green
Зелень.text: **Green** is the element of creation and growth. Green abilities make and manipulate plants, fungi, and other forms of life to hamper foes and nourish your allies.

Пустота.name: Void
Пустота.text: **Void** is the element of the mystery. Void abilities warp space and reality, allowing you to teleport, create illusions, and make things incorporeal.
